limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--saved-history-compact-dark.task: Scan saved conversations and their facts beside the complete saved reply.
conversation--saved-history-compact-dark.observations: The selected release title leads project/date and inline facts. Its complete draft text is readable without an oversized title or doubled compact gutter. Search and Resume remain separated from the independently scrolling reading pane; draft actions and later reply content are reached by scrolling.
